rooms.name: Plank floor
rooms.dm: The grounds under the three oak platforms: two huts, the large outhouse (a brown bear is inside), the trunks that carry the platforms, the stair foot up to the deck. Creatures: brown bear (in the outhouse), 3 apes (guards; usually on the deck).

rooms.name: Deck
rooms.dm: The open deck 10 ft up where the three apes idle. Stair down to the ground, stair-bridge up to the hall. Creatures: 3 apes (with greatswords).

rooms.name: Deck
rooms.desc: The House in the Woods / Noke's Tower interior
rooms.dm: The 60-ft hall 20 ft up: dining room and kitchen (north-west), sitting room (south-west), library and lab (east half). Ahmed Noke works here when not upstairs. Creatures: Ahmed Noke (possibly).

rooms.name: Deck
rooms.desc: The House in the Woods / Noke's Tower interior
rooms.dm: The top platform, 30 ft up: the bedroom. Noke's last stand; the bed becomes the Bed Dragon Wyrmling; the modified wand of true polymorph is here. Creatures: Ahmed Noke, Bed Dragon Wyrmling.
